packageRules.description: Keep the root metro-runtime pin aligned with Expo's Metro toolchain; update it manually in sync with Expo/Metro upgrades.
These native modules are pinned to the versions Expo SDK 54 bundles (expo/bundledNativeModules.json); update them manually, in sync with an Expo SDK upgrade.
Expo SDK 54 owns these versions (expo, expo-*, babel-preset-expo); update them manually in one deliberate Expo SDK upgrade.

Major bumps of tooling and Expo-coupled libraries (TypeScript, Vitest, Vite, jsdom, @babel/core 7, React Navigation 6, async-storage) are done in a deliberate upgrade pass, not one Renovate PR at a time; minor/patch updates still flow.
